% SlideMage template name: Stress test (test only)
%
% A TEST template, not a look to use. It picks the Latin Modern Sans layout profile and
% overrides every hook of the catalog in SlideMage_setup.tex with a value that is clearly
% different from the default: colors, logo and its size, the Top Margin, text margins,
% title bar paddings, footer, footnotes, blocks, frame types and list spacing. If a part of
% the framework still reads a hardcoded number instead of its hook, a deck compiled with
% this template shows it (tools/check_layout.py reads the margins from the PDF, so a
% template with other margins must come out clean). The calibration deck of this project
% exercises every frame type and list depth with it.
%
% It lives here, outside example/ and latex/, so that SlideMage never offers it to users.
% tests/test_template_catalog.py checks that every hook of the catalog is set below.
%
% The values keep the constraints the catalog names where a checker depends on them:
% the footnote text stays smaller than the footer text (3.4pt against 6pt and 5pt), the
% canvas stays white for check_layout.py's test (a tint of 1/255 per channel at most), and
% the content margins stay at or beyond the title bar's.
\newcommand{\SMLayoutProfile}{lmsans}
\input{SlideMage_setup}

% Palette: every color of the catalog.
\definecolor{c_primary_dark}{HTML}{14213d}
\definecolor{c_primary_highlight}{HTML}{c2410c}
\definecolor{c_primary_gray}{HTML}{4b5563}
\definecolor{c_primary_white}{HTML}{FFFFFF}
\definecolor{c_secondary_violet}{HTML}{a5b4fc}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_violet}{HTML}{e0e7ff}
\definecolor{c_secondary_blue}{HTML}{7dd3fc}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_blue}{HTML}{e0f2fe}
\definecolor{c_secondary_green}{HTML}{86efac}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_green}{HTML}{dcfce7}
\definecolor{c_secondary_red}{HTML}{fca5a5}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_red}{HTML}{fee2e2}
\definecolor{c_secondary_orange}{HTML}{fdba74}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_orange}{HTML}{ffedd5}
\definecolor{c_secondary_yellow}{HTML}{fde047}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_yellow}{HTML}{fef08a}
\definecolor{c_tertiary_gray}{HTML}{e5e7eb}
\definecolor{c_custom_gray}{HTML}{1f2937}
\definecolor{c_custom_red}{HTML}{b91c1c}
\definecolor{c_custom_green}{HTML}{15803d}
\definecolor{c_custom_brown}{HTML}{92400e}

% Roles.
\renewcommand{\SMBulletColor}{c_custom_green}
\renewcommand{\SMTitleBoxColor}{c_custom_green}
\renewcommand{\SMTitleTextColor}{c_primary_white}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterBoxColorDefault}{c_primary_gray}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterTextColor}{c_primary_white}

% Optional colors.
\definecolor{SMCanvasColor}{HTML}{FFFEFC}
\definecolor{SMCardBackgroundColor}{HTML}{f5f3ff}
\definecolor{SMCardBorderColor}{HTML}{14213d}
\definecolor{SMProcessBorderColor}{HTML}{9ca3af}
\definecolor{SMCodeKeywordColor}{HTML}{b91c1c}
\definecolor{SMCodeCommentColor}{HTML}{4b5563}
\definecolor{SMCodeBackgroundColor}{HTML}{fef9c3}
\definecolor{SMCodeTextColor}{HTML}{1f2937}

% Logo: another file, and bigger.
\renewcommand{\SMInstituteLogoPath}{media/chapter-logo-building-blocks.pdf}
\setlength{\SMLogoHeight}{4.5ex}

% Top Margin (the coordinates that follow from it and the title bar are derived).
\renewcommand{\SMTopMargin}{50bp}

% Text margins.
\setlength{\SMTextMarginLeft}{0.7cm}
\setlength{\SMTextMarginRight}{0.6cm}

% Frame title bar.
\setlength{\SMFrametitleTopPadding}{3ex}
\setlength{\SMFrametitleBottomPadding}{2.6ex}
\setlength{\SMFrametitleLeftPadding}{3.2ex}
\setlength{\SMFrametitleRightPadding}{0.5cm}
\renewcommand{\SMFrameSubtitleSep}{\ \textbar\ }
\setlength{\SMFrameSubtitleStrutEnd}{2pt}

% Footer and footnotes.
\setlength{\SMFooterBoxHeight}{9pt}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterTextSize}{\fontsize{6}{4}\selectfont}
\renewcommand{\SMFooterIDSize}{\fontsize{5}{5}\selectfont}
\setlength{\SMFootlineHeight}{2ex}
\setlength{\SMFootlineDepth}{0.2ex}
\renewcommand{\SMFootlineSidePadding}{4ex}
\setlength{\SMRightFooterPadding}{4.5ex}
\setlength{\SMFootlineVOffset}{-0.1ex+0.4pt}
\renewcommand{\SMFootnoteSize}{\fontsize{3.4}{2.1}\selectfont}
\setlength{\SMFootnoteSep}{4pt}
\setlength{\SMSideFootnoteHsize}{190pt}
\setlength{\SMSideFootnoteTopSep}{5pt}
\setlength{\SMSideFootnoteRightInset}{4pt}
\setlength{\SMSideFootnoteMarkerShift}{2pt}

% Blocks, and the sizes of the texts that are beamer fonts.
\setlength{\SMBlockSideMargin}{6pt}
\setlength{\SMBlockTitleMarkerWidth}{18pt}
\setbeamerfont{block title}{size=\normalsize}
\setbeamerfont{frametitle}{size=\Large}
\setbeamerfont{caption}{size=\footnotesize}

% Frame types.
\setlength{\SMTitleframeBoxHeight}{178pt}
\setlength{\SMTitleframeTextSep}{3.5ex}
\setlength{\SMTitleframeBandGap}{1.2ex}
\setlength{\SMTitleframeBottomPad}{55pt}
\setlength{\SMSectionframeBoxHeight}{100pt}
\setlength{\SMSectionframeContentDrop}{14pt}
\setlength{\SMQuoteBoxHeight}{0.7\paperheight}
\setlength{\SMQuoteAttributionGap}{2.5ex}
\setlength{\SMProgressStripHeight}{13pt}

% Lists.
\renewcommand{\SMItemsepRatioI}{0.5}
\renewcommand{\SMItemsepRatioII}{0.3}
\renewcommand{\SMItemsepRatioIII}{0.2}
\renewcommand{\SMItemsepRatioIV}{0.12}
\renewcommand{\SMItemizeLevelDropSpaceRatioI}{0.6}
\renewcommand{\SMItemizeLevelDropSpaceRatioII}{0.4}
\renewcommand{\SMItemizeLevelDropSpaceRatioIII}{0.3}
\renewcommand{\SMItemizeLevelDropSpaceRatioIV}{0.6}
\renewcommand{\SMItemizeLevelOpenSpaceRatioI}{0.05}
\renewcommand{\SMItemizeLevelOpenSpaceRatioII}{0.2}
\renewcommand{\SMItemizeLevelOpenSpaceRatioIII}{0.05}
\renewcommand{\SMTallItemBaseRatio}{0.4}
\setlength{\SMLabelItemItemsep}{3.5pt}
\setlength{\SMTightDisplaySkip}{5pt}
\renewcommand{\SMBesideFigureTopGap}{0.4em}

% Drawings, code.
\setlength{\SMImageBorderWidth}{3.5pt}
\setlength{\SMWarningSignPadding}{8pt}
\setlength{\SMWarningSignBorderWidth}{3pt}
\renewcommand{\SMCodeSize}{\fontsize{6.2}{7.8}\selectfont}

% The optional theme features (mini frames, progress bar, divider frames, watermark): on
% in the stress deck only, which defines \StressOptionalFeatures. The calibration deck
% stays plain, so that tools/check_layout.py has the ordinary chrome to measure.
\ifdefined\StressOptionalFeatures
	\SMMiniFramesPosition{head}
	\SMProgressBarPosition{foot}
	\SMDividerFrames{section}
	\SMWatermarkDefault{true}
\fi

\input{SlideMage_base}
